welcome:
🔥 *Welcome to Synergix!*

Your mind is now part of the world's first decentralized collective intelligence. Every idea you share will be immortalized on the BNB Greenfield blockchain.

🌱 You start as an *Initiate*. Contribute, earn points and ascend to become an *Oracle*.

🧠 The network grows with you. Your wisdom is eternal.
welcome_back:
🌟 *Welcome back, brilliant mind!*

Synergix has been waiting for you. The network has grown since your last visit and your legacy remains intact.

🔥 Ready to keep immortalizing wisdom?
memory_empty:
🧠 You haven't immortalized any wisdom on the network yet.

🔥 Tap *Contribute* and leave your first eternal mark.
contribution_mode:
🎯 *Contribution mode activated*

Write your idea, reflection or knowledge. It will be recorded forever on the Synergix network.

💡 Minimum 20 characters.
✨ Be original, be deep, be eternal.
